engine.notes: San Antonio's improv presence online is thin: ComedySportz San Antonio's domains did not resolve or timed out, so its status is unconfirmed, and no improv school with its own site was found in this pass; the city's verifiable improv is a late-night troupe resident at a scripted theater.

entries.name: The Denials at The Overtime Theater
entries.summary: San Antonio's longest continuously running improv group plays adult-oriented suggestion-based shows every Saturday at 10:30pm in the Gregg Barrios Theatre at The Overtime Theater, 4335 Vance Jackson Road, which also offers improv workshops.
entries.schedule: Saturdays 10:30pm, $8 at the box office, most weekends
signals: The Denials' own domain points to Bandcamp
entries.reasons: A durable weekly show with a permanent host theater, but no school, no jam and a show page whose season listings were a year old when read.
